types.label: Commerce full user
types.notes: D365 Commerce base licence (HQ/merchandising users). Same operations storage accrual as Finance/SCM full users per the licensing guide capacity table. Store staff usually use Operations – Device or Activity instead.

types.label: CE Premium (Sales / Customer Service / Contact Center)
types.notes: CE storage entitlements accrue to Dataverse per the Power Platform guide; extend accrualGB if CE is primary.

types.label: Attach license
types.notes: Adds no storage entitlement. Counts toward Copilot Studio credit entitlement (mirrors source workbook).

tenantBases.notes: Tenant base when any F&SCM Premium license is present.
Tenant base when any F&SCM or Commerce full user license is present (no Premium). The licensing guide capacity table puts Commerce in the same row as Finance/SCM.

addons.label: Customer Insights entitlement
addons.notes: Additional Dataverse entitlement when Customer Insights is licensed.

billingPools.label: Data (F&SCM + Dataverse)
billingPools.notes: Merged capacity model: F&SCM database and Dataverse database are one billable pool, so spare entitlement in one covers demand in the other. Both add-on SKUs list at the same price, so either price ref gives the same number.

billingPools.label: File (F&SCM + Dataverse)
billingPools.notes: Merged capacity model: F&SCM file and Dataverse file are one billable pool. Both add-on SKUs list at the same price.

billingPools.label: Dataverse log
billingPools.notes: Tracked but never billed by default (mirrors the source workbook). Give it a priceId to charge it.
